newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit rises on spinoff hope.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit rises on spinoff hope.

text.p: Shares in Leading Spirit Holdings Co Ltd were boosted on Tuesday morning after the company said it was considering a spin-off its home electrical appliance division, brokers said.
The shares rose HK$0.11 or 7.9 per cent to HK$1.51 at midday on volume of 48.3 million shares worth HK$72.11 million.
Brokers said expectation of a possible exceptional gain from the proposed spin-off fueled short term buying.
"This is a highly speculative stock and investors just take the news (of the proposed spin-off) as an excuse to buy up the shares in this company," one broker said.
Leading Spirit said on Monday it was "seriously considering" a proposal to spin off its home electrical appliance division.
Leading Spirit supplies components for television, audio and household appliances.
